AIDS living with AIDS->AIDS living with AIDS
AIDS living with AIDS->AIDS living with AIDS
param: Ψ Constant recruitment rate into the adult susceptible population (all groups combined)
θ Proportion of recruited individuals who are men
γ Proportion of recruited men who are heterosexual (so 1-γ are homosexual men)
λ_h Force of infection acting on susceptible homosexual men (defined by sexual contacts; treated as an external/model-defined expression in the paper)
λ_m Force of infection from heterosexual men acting on susceptible women (male-to-female transmission component)
λ_hw Force of infection from homosexual men acting on susceptible women (homosexual-men-to-women transmission component)
λ_w Force of infection from women acting on susceptible heterosexual men (female-to-male transmission component)
λ_hm Force of infection from homosexual men acting on susceptible heterosexual men (homosexual-men-to-heterosexual-men transmission component)
μ Natural mortality rate (applies to all compartments)
α Departure/progression rate from infected (HIV) compartments into treatment (ART) or AIDS (untreated); described as the departure rate from infected individuals
p Proportion of infected individuals who enroll in ART upon leaving infected class
δ AIDS development rate in treated individuals due to ART resistance or treatment failure (T → A)
d Induced disease mortality rate for individuals living with AIDS
